Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.diIg.com.Ph 27 DEC OPINON No. gs HON. JOSE BILMAR F. DAMPOG Highest-ranking Sangguniang Bayan Member Sangguniang Bayan of Dumarao Province of Capiz Dear Hon. Dampog: S. 2013 This has reference to your letter dated 20 August 2019 seeking for clarification on who between the Acting Mayor and the Acting Vice Mayor shall be considered as the Sangguniang Bayan Presiding Officer with respect to the acceptance of resignation of Sangguniang Kabataan Panngbayan Pederasyong (SKPP) President. In the letter of MLGOO Alvero, the facts stated are as follows: I. On 04 June 2019, Sangguniang Bayan (SB) of Dumarao, Capiz, received a letter dated 03 June 2019 from Vrinda I. Katalbas, Sangguniang Kabataan Pambayang Pederasyon (SKPP) President, revoking her Irrevocable resignation, which, she alleged that she was forced to sign; 2. There was no action made by the Sanggunian or the Presiding Officer for the reason that no resignation letter was received by the SB in the first place; 3. On 17 June 2019, the SB received an irrevocable resignation letter dated 06 June 2019 from SKPP President Katalbas; 4. On 09 August 2019, Municipal Mayor E dgardo Arancillo left for the United States. Consequently, Vice Mayor Leslie Warren A. Benjamin assumed as Acting Mayor and you, as the highest-ranking SB member, assumed as Acting Vice Mayor; and 5. On 22 August 2019, you sent a letter seeking clarification as to who between you and Vice Mayor Benjamin shall be considered as the Presiding Officer based on Section 39(a) of DILG-COMELEC-NYC Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2017- 01 (JMC 2017-01), dated 23 June 2017, entitled "Guidelines

on the Conduct of Sangguniang Kabataan Pederasyon Election; and Rules Governing Terms of Office, Suspension and Removal of all SK Pederasyon Officers." We are cognizant that the issue in this case is already moot and academic. Notwithstanding, we deem it beneficial to answer the query for the mere purpose of academic discussion. This is without prejudice to consummated acts of the pertinent local government official/s, which already enjoy presumption of regularity. We are of the view that it is Vice Mayor Benjamin who shall be considered as the Presiding Officer. The time the SB received the revocation letter and the resignation letter of SKPP President Katalbas and the period within which the SB Presiding Officer should have accepted such resignation, if so, it was Vice Mayor Benjamin who was the Presiding Officer of the SB. During that time, there was yet a temporary vacancy in the Office of the Mayor, thus, there was no resultant vacancy in the office of the Vice Mayor to be filled up by the highest-ranking SB member. Therefore, there should be no confusion as to who the Presiding Officer was for the time being. Sections 39 of JMC 2017-01 is relevant. It states: e. I. 2. 3. f. g. h. "SECTION 39. RESIGNATION Resignation of any SK Pederasyon officer at all levels shall be deemed effective only upon acceptance by the following authorities: Presiding Officer of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, in the case of Pan/alawigan Pederasyon President; Presiding Officer of Sangguniang Panlungsod/Bayan, in the of case Panlungsod/Pambayang Pederasyon President; and President of the Pederasyon concerned, in the case of other officers of the Pederasyon. The resignation shall be deemed accepted if not acted upon by the authority concerned within fifteen (15) days from receipt thereof. Irrevocable resignations by any Pederasyon Presidents or other Pederasyon officer be deemed accepted upon presentation before an open session of the sanggunian or the concerned Pederasyon, as the case may be, and duly entered in its records. Copies of the resignation letters, together with the action taken by the aforesaid authorities, shall be

furnished the Department of the Interior and Local Government; " We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, By the authority of the Secretary MARIVEL C. ACENDONCILLO, CESO 11 Undersecr tary for Local Government
